name: external-effect retryability/idempotency gate
purpose: Prevent the role-local CAS/event kernel from being incorrectly generalized into exactly-once external side effects.

public_sources.title: AWS Builders' Library: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
public_sources.relevance: AWS describes the ambiguity after a timeout, safe retries via caller-provided request identifiers, and the need for the service-side idempotency record plus mutation to be atomic.

public_sources.title: Google Cloud: Idempotency
public_sources.relevance: Repeated idempotent requests have the same final effect; non-idempotent creates need explicit idempotency logic/keys for safe retry.

indistinguishability_negative_result.setup: Local durable state contains INTENT(op_id, params) and no RECEIPT. The role calls a non-idempotent external create/effect that exposes neither an idempotency key nor a queryable stable effect identity. The invocation loses the response or stops before recording a receipt.
indistinguishability_negative_result.world_0: The remote effect did not execute.
indistinguishability_negative_result.world_1: The remote effect executed exactly once, but the local role did not observe/record the result.
indistinguishability_negative_result.local_observation_on_recovery: Identical in world_0 and world_1: intent present, receipt absent.
indistinguishability_negative_result.if_retry: world_1 can execute the effect twice, violating at-most-once.
indistinguishability_negative_result.if_do_not_retry: world_0 can leave the effect unexecuted, violating at-least-once.
indistinguishability_negative_result.conclusion: Repository CAS/idempotency state alone cannot guarantee exactly-once for such an opaque non-idempotent external effect. A richer/manual reconciliation step would not be an accepted Phase-1 solution, so this effect class remains unresolved until the downstream surface supplies safe identity/reconciliation semantics.

acceptance_classes.criterion: Repeating the same effect request has no additional material side effect.
acceptance_classes.retry_rule: Retry after reconstruction/backoff; record receipt after authoritative observation.

acceptance_classes.criterion: Downstream accepts a caller-stable idempotency/client request token and duplicate requests with the same token do not repeat the logical effect.
acceptance_classes.retry_rule: Persist op_id before call; reuse exactly the same downstream idempotency token on every retry; record returned effect identity/result.

acceptance_classes.criterion: Effect is created/updated under a deterministic unique resource identity that can be queried after ambiguity, or duplicate create returns a stable conflict that can be fetched and compared.
acceptance_classes.retry_rule: On ambiguous/crash recovery, query deterministic identity first; reuse if semantically equal, otherwise checkpoint conflict.

acceptance_classes.criterion: No idempotency token, no natural idempotence and no reliable query by a caller-stable identity.
acceptance_classes.retry_rule: UNRESOLVED: do not claim exactly-once parity.

live_positive_example.surface: GitHub repository contents create/update inside the authorized role-local namespace
live_positive_example.evidence: Deterministic content path can be fetched after a 409 and compared; mutable HEAD update requires the previously fetched blob SHA. r132/r133 observed both deterministic retry and stale-writer 409 behavior.

effect_wrapper_protocol: If receipt/result for op_id is already authoritative, DONE_NOOP.
Classify downstream action under this gate before first execution.
Persist immutable INTENT with stable op_id and canonical parameters.
Execute only if class is naturally idempotent, server-idempotency-key, or query-reconcilable stable identity; otherwise leave unresolved.
After timeout/interruption, reconcile/query or retry with the identical downstream key according to the class; never mint a new logical key for the same op_id.
Persist immutable RECEIPT/effect identity then CAS-publish completion.
A receipt write failure is safe only because the downstream action is already retry/reconcile safe.

phase1_impact.strengthens: the existing state/orchestration kernel into a safe wrapper for compatible connector effects
phase1_impact.falsifies: the assumption that durable local op_ids alone make every external side effect exactly-once
phase1_impact.quota_dependency: none added; each candidate connector still needs its own zero-optional-quota assessment

exact_next_action: Before promoting any connector-based effect substitute in the effect-class matrix, require it to pass this idempotency gate and the role's write-authority boundary. Prefer an authorized stable-resource update as the next live effect test; keep opaque create actions unresolved.
